supporting_observations.claim: The supplied account-creation event records c.rwong being created at 13:46:43 UTC by ruth.moss, rather than at exactly 13:42 UTC as stated in the alert.
The creation event uses logon ID 0x471f200, matching a 13:42:41 network logon for ruth.moss from WS-RMOSS-01.
The account name c.rwong matches the stated temporary-account naming convention, and the supplied group-addition event shows the account added to Seasonal.

The supplied records show ruth.moss connecting by RDP from WS-RMOSS-01 to DC-BLU-01, then launching GPMC and making RPC, LDAP, and SMB connections to the domain controller. This differs from the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-KITO-01, but does not by itself establish malicious intent.
The supplied events show addition to Seasonal but do not establish the account's complete group membership or whether it received any other privileges.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy log collection was reported unavailable for 13:25–14:10 UTC on 2026-09-29, limiting proxy visibility during part of the review window.
The supplied records do not include a complete account-membership or privilege-change history for c.rwong.
